alternate_names: Sri Shirdi Sai Baba Spiritual Center, Seethammadhara

history.summary: Sai Baba temple complex on Shirdi Marg, Seethammadhara, Visakhapatnam. Founded by Sri Ram Gopal (foundation stone 10 May 1985 for the temple, prayer hall and children's park) and maintained as a private property rather than a trust. The complex holds a 3-ft marble Sai Baba statue on an elevated platform under a carved wooden mantap, a replica of Sai Baba's Dwarakamai on the first floor, Sai's dhuni, and sanctums for Ganapathi, Jagannatha, Venkateswara, Hanuman, Kanaka Durga, Subramanya, Ayyappa, Saraswathi, Navagraha and others, fronted by a carved raja gopuram. FLAG -- uncertain identity: the CSV name 'Sri Shirdi Sai Mandir' is generic and several Sai mandirs exist in Visakhapatnam (East Point Colony, Akkayyapalem/NH16, Shipyard Colony-Gandhigram, Seethammadhara). Mapped provisionally to the Seethammadhara Spiritual Center as the best-documented (verify intended referent). Coordinates are a street-level geocode of Shirdi Marg, approximate. Image: no reliable image after repeated searching (blog-hosted photos timed out on every fetch); media left empty.

name: Sri Shirdi Sai Mandir
town_description: Visakhapatnam (Vizag) is Andhra Pradesh's largest city and a major port on the Bay of Bengal, backed by the Eastern Ghats. Seethammadhara is a residential locality in the city, home to several Sai Baba temples including the Spiritual Center on Shirdi Marg.

travel.railway: Visakhapatnam Junction railway station (a few km away)
travel.road: Shirdi Marg, Seethammadhara (off the SFS School road); reachable by city buses and autos

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Thursdays and Guru Purnima for special worship
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00-10:30 AM and 5:30-8:30 PM; Thursdays 6:00 AM-12:30 PM and 5:30-10:00 PM, per the temple's documented timings (aarti: Kakad 6:15 AM, Dhoop 6:00 PM, Shej 8:00 PM)
